findings.title: Modified monitor config is discarded instead of returned
findings.body: get_monitor_environment_context copies monitor_environment.monitor.config, rewrites schedule_type with the human-readable display value, but then returns the original monitor_environment.monitor.config instead of the modified local config. As a result the prepared config is unused and the monitor context sent with incident occurrences retains the raw schedule_type value rather than the intended display value.
